text: Psalm 67 For the Music Director. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song. May God be gracious to us, and bless us, and cause His face to shine on us; Selah
that Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy; for You will judge the people uprightly, and lead the nations on earth. Selah
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Then will the earth yield its produce, and God, our God, will bless us.
God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear Him.
